light: a dim, near-dark hall; one single beam of pale light falls from a high window onto the foot of the statue; dust floating in the beam
bg: Inside the dark empty meeting hall of the Theatre of Pompey in Rome: the foot of a tall marble statue of Pompey the Great on a pedestal, in the dark empty meeting hall of the Theatre of Pompey in Rome; marble floor, columns fading into darkness. At its base, on the right half of the frame: Julius Caesar, an older Roman in a white toga with a purple border, sinking down at the base of a statue pedestal on the right half of the frame, drawing the fold of his toga up over his head so his face is hidden; a quiet, tragic, dignified pose. No blood, no wounds, no weapons.
